thread:
tom_sales: Heads up 3 MedAxis just asked for an enterprise POC with a heavy discount. Need deal desk guidance fast.

rachel_ae: Quick background: MedAxis is a regional healthcare SaaS provider. If POC converts they could add multiple teams across EU+US, TAM ~300k ARR. They want an 8-week dedicated trial with EU data residency.

tom_sales: They
sked for 45% off list for the trial period citing competitive bids. Trial start target mid-June.

priya_dealdesk: 45% is outside standard concession band. Questions: is this for hosted or reserved/dedicated infra? What's projected token/compute burn? Any ask for liability changes?

rachel_ae: It's for Dedicated trial (2 nodes, low-latency routing). Expected utilization ~100M tokens/month + model eval runs that spike. They asked for a short, limited liability SOW and an expedited NDA addendum for PHI adjacency concerns.

liam_infra: Dedicated trial will need capacity planning. Two nodes reserved for 8 weeks means we may need to block capacity; ops cost is non-trivial. If the trial is scheduled in a low-util window we can optimize but can't promise zero interference. Recommend a surge protection clause.

nate_finance: High level: 45% discount on dedicated infra will drive contribution negative for trial unless there's a strong commitment. We can tolerate up to 30% standard concession for trials. Anything above needs VP approval and clear ACV / ROI. Please add the usage numbers into the shared econ workbook.

priya_dealdesk: Deal desk suggestion: Offer an "Eval Concession" at 30% for the 8-week trial in exchange for: 1) Signed SOW + PO before kickoff 2) 12-month commit within 21 days post-trial, minimum $200k ARR 3) Public case study / customer reference 4) Data residency spec in SOW and acceptance of our liability cap.

rachel_ae: MedAxis pushing back 3 they want 40-45% because the hospital buyers have a strict procurement threshold. They
re willing to do public reference but need tighter residency language and additional audit support.

priya_dealdesk: If AE confirms reference and markeing co-sell, we can flex to 35% but need finance & legal sign-off. For 40%+ we need VP sign-off and business justification (logo, displacement of competitor, market access).

nate_finance: I'll approve 35% conditional on: ARR >= $200k, first 30 days of post-trial commit invoiced up-front, and an overage clause (if token use > forecast by 50%, bill at list rates). Any more than 35% needs explicit VP approval and a modeled margin hit sign-off.

legal_bot: Legal note: PHI adjacency requires precise processing/storage language. We can add SOC2 attestation language and an audit right in SOW but cannot expand liability beyond 1x fees without escalation. Also need exact EU-residency data flow text.

liam_infra: Ops asks: build surge clause, optional reserved-to-shared fallback if utilization is low, and an SLA toggle that ramps to production SLA only after commit. Include an auto-scale buffer at additional cost.

priya_dealdesk: For VP escalation items, we need: explicit ACV forecast, strategic rationale, marketing/reference commitment, finance margin sign-off, and legal redlines attached. Please compile in a single doc.

rachel_ae: I'll confirm reference and marketing commitment with the customer and push them to sign SOW + PO. Also uploading the draft SOW with residency and audit text here.

tom_sales: Proposed counter to customer:

```
- Trial: 8 weeks dedicated trial (2 nodes A100 equiv)
- Discount: 35% off list during trial (conditional)
- Commit: 12-month minimum at $200k ARR post-trial, first month invoiced up-front
- Conditions: Signed SOW + PO prior to start, SOC attestation provided, EU data residency clause in SOW
- Ops: surge clause + overage billing at list if usage >150% forecast
- Legal: standard MSA + limited PHI adjacency language; liability cap 1x fees for trial
```

rachel_ae: MedAxis verbally accepted 35% as a counter but asked for written confirmation about residency and SOC before signing.

nate_finance: Finance to confirm: 35% concession approved conditional on $200k ARR and upfront invoice. Overages billed at list.

legal_bot: I'll review the uploaded SOW and provide final redlines on residency clauses.

priya_dealdesk: Provisional approval: 35% booked. Once PO and signed SOW are uploaded here and finance confirms upfront payment, deal desk will finalize. Send VP if customer pushes past 35%.

support_bot: Reminder: attach SOW + PO to thread for audit within 72h.

rachel_ae: Uploaded signed PO and countersigned SOW (see attached). Customer confirmed SOC report will be provided within 10 business days.

priya_dealdesk: Verified docs; finance confirmed receipt of upfront invoice. Deal desk approves 35% Eval Concession. Move to "contracting - legal finalize" and track as deal/medaxis-17700 in SFDC. :white_check_mark:

nate_finance: Thanks all. Please monitor actual consumption and flag any >50% deviation.

tom_sales: Closing the loop with customer and scheduling kickoff. Thanks team. :rocket:
